resources.purpose: Ephemeral source role trusted only by the verified deployment principal
Allow only a 300-second RS256 sts:GetWebIdentityToken assertion for the Entra exchange audience
Isolated destination ownership and one-step residual inventory boundary
Ephemeral Entra federation target
Trust only the AWS outbound issuer, source-role subject, and AzureADTokenExchange audience
Temporary Reader assignment on the probe resource group for one harmless ARM GET

validation_steps: Assume the ephemeral AWS source role from the verified deployment principal.
Use the runtime AWS outbound assertion contract to obtain one 300-second RS256 assertion for api://AzureADTokenExchange.
Exchange the assertion through the managed-identity federated credential for one ARM access token.
Perform one ARM GET of the destination managed identity and retain only typed status and timestamps.
probes.success_condition: The AWS role subject is accepted by Entra and the federated Azure identity completes exactly one authorized ARM GET.
cleanup_order: Remove the Azure Reader role assignment.
Delete the Azure federated identity credential and managed identity.
Delete the isolated Azure resource group.
Delete the AWS inline policy and source role.
residual_inventory_checks: AWS IAM get/list by exact materialized names returns no probe role or inline policy.
Azure Resource Graph and Entra identity lookup return no active object with the probe prefix.

research_question_alignment.rq1: Measures the operational effort and elapsed time of one exact directed identity prerequisite.
research_question_alignment.rq2: Checks functional interoperability of the implemented AWS-to-Azure workload-identity contract without deploying a Twin.
research_question_alignment.rq3: Separates identity setup and cleanup cost from Event-Layer and full-scenario cost.

resources.purpose: Ephemeral AWS source role with no destination-data policy
Ephemeral service-account impersonation target without project data roles
Isolated AWS workload-identity federation boundary
Trust only assumed-role subjects for the ephemeral AWS source role
Grant workloadIdentityUser only to the mapped ephemeral AWS role

validation_steps: Assume the ephemeral AWS source role from the verified deployment principal.
Construct the runtime-compatible signed AWS GetCallerIdentity subject token in memory.
Exchange the subject token at GCP STS through the exact role-bound provider.
Impersonate the target service account once and retain only typed status and timestamps.
probes.success_condition: GCP accepts only the ephemeral AWS assumed-role subject and issues exactly one target-service-account access token.
cleanup_order: Remove the GCP service-account workloadIdentityUser binding.
Delete the GCP workload-identity provider and pool.
Delete the GCP target service account.
Delete the AWS source role.
residual_inventory_checks: AWS IAM get/list by exact materialized name returns no active probe role.
GCP IAM lists no active probe service account, pool, provider, or binding.
GCP show-deleted inventory contains only the recorded, non-usable soft-delete tombstones and their purge times.

resources.purpose: Isolated Azure source and runner ownership boundary
Exact managed-identity assertion source
Dedicated secretless source assertion audience
Bind the deployment-shaped api:// assertion audience
Expose only the EventBridge.Exchange application role
Assignment-required audience service principal
Authorize only the ephemeral source managed identity for the exchange audience
Five-minute maximum, no-ingress managed-identity assertion runner
Trust the configured Entra tenant issuer only for the probe audience
Target role constrained to source managed-identity subject and custom audience, with no data policy

validation_steps: Wait for the Entra application-role assignment to become readable before creating the billable runner.
Run the pinned, no-ingress Azure container with the source managed identity for at most 300 seconds.
Use the runtime managed-identity assertion contract to obtain one custom-audience OIDC assertion in memory.
Call AWS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity and then one STS GetCallerIdentity; emit only a typed result code.
probes.success_condition: AWS accepts only the expected Entra tenant, audience, and managed-identity subject and the resulting role session completes one STS identity check.
cleanup_order: Delete the AWS target role and OIDC provider.
Stop and delete the Azure container instance group.
Delete the Entra app-role assignment, service principal, and application.
Delete the Azure managed identity and isolated resource group.
residual_inventory_checks: AWS IAM returns no active probe role or OIDC provider.
Azure Resource Graph returns no active probe resource and no running container group.
Microsoft Graph returns no active application, service principal, or app-role assignment with the probe prefix.
